# Ultimate Odycer Docs — LLM entry point

> Public, bilingual documentation for Ultimate Odycer. Documentation is not runtime authority and does not authorize server/device mutation, publication, credentials use, purchase, or network exposure.

- [LLM/agent safety and proof rules](docs/llm/README.md)

For maturity/compatibility claims, `current-proof-state.json` overrides stale descriptive wording in the navigation index. Exact executable receipts tied to named revisions override both.

## Critical rules for coding agents

- Do not invent unpublished protocol details, production endpoints, credentials, runtime compatibility, or a player WebSocket endpoint.
- `SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_ONLY` is not `REAL_SERVER_E2E`.
- Godot engine load, OpenXR init, headset runtime, and Zig interoperability are separate proof gates.
- Three.js synthetic transport is validated only as synthetic; canonical Zig live remains `NOT_PROVEN`.
- The current server-network document describes raw binary TCP but may not be called a verified canonical protocol until tied to an exact Zig SHA/tree/toolchain baseline.
- Historical Godot VR networking is `LEGACY_QUARANTINED`; do not reuse it without provenance, license and security review.
- A type declaration, UI component, HTTP 2xx, endpoint string match, mock fixture, or green synthetic test is never enough to claim production behavior.
- Private server/game implementation and production configuration are proprietary/commercial, all rights reserved unless explicitly licensed otherwise. Public repositories retain their explicit public licenses.
